title: M2 Chatticus chat core published as reusable packages
description: In the Chatticus repository: publish the chat core so other systems depend on it instead of copying it: the turn and SSE stream protocol, the durable turn runner and agent loop, and the client chat components with brand tokens. Versioned releases with a changelog; Papyrus pins exact versions like it pins its own packages. Work tracked in Chatticus's Kanbus, linked from here.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
User reviewed the architectural plan, briefly approved implementation, then requested that implementation stop and planning be filed/pushed for a Mac agent. No production code changed. Full plan: docs/chatticus-chat-integration-plan.md; five checked Archify illustrations: docs/architecture/chatticus-chat/. Resume instructions: docs/architecture/chatticus-chat/handoff.md.

Clarification: current Chatticus uses TypeScript Pi Durable 1.0.2; no Python package was identified. UI/client extraction does not depend on a Python migration. Later shared-server extraction should reuse the existing TypeScript implementation, with an explicit Papyrus backend-hosting/policy decision. Earlier PyAgents/PyDurable wording should not cause a new Python chat engine to be built.

Chatticus planning branch: docs/chatticus-080b0e-papyrus-chat-handoff (chatticus-abde29 / chatticus-080b0e). Papyrus branch: docs/PPY-eeb023-chatticus-chat-plan. Keep all implementation records open. No package publication, merge, deployment or security-access change is authorized by this handoff. Coordinate with the other task owning loading states, Notification Center focus/removal of Go to, and mobile navigation alignment; the chat slice owns shared packages and the console adapter.
